newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil closes higher on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil closes higher on technical rebound.

text.p: Late short-covering and speculative buying helped recoup early losses and Malaysian palm oil prices closed mostly higher, traders said.
"The market looked oversold this morning and yesterday, and we saw some covering and bargain hunting at the lower levels," a trader said. "The rise was just a technical rebound."
Traders said there was some covering ahead of a crop report from forecaster Ivan Wong on Friday.
"The market has fallen quite substantially and shortcovering is expected. Chartwise, it is improving and we may see the next resistance at 1,250 ringgit," a chartist said.
"If covering continues tomorrow (Friday) and May futures break the 1,250 level, there is no problem for the contract to rise to 1,260-1,265 ringgit before the PORLA data," another trader said.
"Prices fell to a low of 1,218 ringgit this morning due to weak soyoil but rebounded particularly in late dealing."
May futures recovered to finish eight ringgit up at 1,244 ringgit ($502.42) a tonne.
The market is also waiting for official February crop data from the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) on Saturday.
The market has earlier extended Wednesday's falls as sentiment was hit by the weakness in soyoil after a bearish USDA report and technical selling.
Trading was volatile and turnover on the futures market was 3,139 lots.

Among physicals, Mar (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,285 ringgit against bids of 1,280 after trading from 1,275 to 1,280. Mar (central) saw offers at 1,270 against bids of 1,260 and Mar (north) at 1,255 against 1,240.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,280 with bids at 1,270, with transactions from 1,260 to 1,270, and Apr (central) at 1,267.50 against 1,262.50.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $545 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May at $537.50 and Jun at $535. Apr was traded at $535, $537 and $540.

Mar RBD palm olein saw offers at $585, Apr at $577.50 and May/Jun at $570. Mar was dealt at $580 and Apr at $570 and $572.50. Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $450 and Mar/Apr palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $310.
